themes: The Prophet as the best example
Good character for men and women
summary_for_children: Al-Ahzab means The Confederates. It recalls how armies gathered against the believers and Allah sent a wind against them. It says the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is the best example and describes qualities of believing men and women.
world_title: The Trench and the Excellent Example
environment_concept: Wind sweeping through empty tents (33:9) and mountains that stand for the trust (33:72, symbolic).
architecture_and_scenery: Low mud-brick houses, a long defensive trench, a windy plain, and a mountain range rejecting a heavy trust.

palette.lighting: Cold wind and dust, then clear sky

areas.name: The Windy Plain
areas.description: Wind sweeping through empty tents; no one is shown.

areas.name: Mountains of the Trust
areas.description: Mountains that declined to bear the trust: symbolic.

activities.name: Qualities wall
activities.description: Carry five stones to build a wall of good qualities.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Remember often
activities.description: Light lamps morning and evening by reading the ayah.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration focuses on character and steadfastness; the Prophet (peace be upon him) and his companions are never shown or voiced.
learning_objectives: Explain why the Prophet (peace be upon him) is the best example

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (mountain, tents, wind) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
